$comment: Lebanon's municipalities for the searchable municipality field (owner, 9 October 2026). Source: seven governorate lists the owner sent on 9 October 2026 (North, Akkar, Baalbek-Hermel, Bekaa, Mount Lebanon, South (file 'Saida'), Nabatieh), 793 rows, English only. Corrections, each recorded in 'corrections': the files reverse the word order of every multi-word name and district ('Aakrine Ain', 'Chouf El'), restored here; one name was wrapped over two lines; one row was a scraped sentence; one row was listed twice. Beirut, which no file covers, is added. One Akkar row carried only an Arabic name (حوبش) and is left out until its English name is known. ARABIC NAMES ARE PENDING: the files carry none, and none is invented here -- until they arrive the Arabic page shows the English name. Spellings are the files' own ('Aakkar', 'Kesrouane'). Two places of the same name are told apart by their district in brackets.
source: Owner, 9 October 2026: seven governorate PDFs (English only).
